assets.purpose: 实时视频开场首帧（interactive-game.json video.first_frame）、开始前的舞台海报、角色与风格锚点
assets.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, 16:9, 35mm grain, halation. Late spring rooftop of a seaside town; East Asian teenage girl Gaia, short black bob, oversized faded olive-green work jacket, white tee, worn white canvas sneakers, kneels on an old cylindrical water tank painting it fresh green; warm yellow-green slightly overexposed handheld feel; mother as backlit silhouette with paint can, face hidden; laundry lines, antennas, calm sea; faint artificial ring in the sky near a daytime moon. No text.

assets.purpose: 第二段「断」章节叠化静帧（Ken Burns 2%），等待生成时的氛围层
assets.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, 16:9, same girl Gaia (short black bob, olive-green work jacket, white canvas sneakers) seen small from behind, standing on a wide exposed wet seabed where the sea has retreated hundreds of meters; grey-white cold desaturated palette, locked-off static camera, overcast flat light, the full moon in the pale sky with a thin dark crack across its face. Film grain, vignette. No text.

assets.purpose: 第三段「途」章节叠化静帧
assets.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, 16:9, horizon tilted about 2 degrees. Sickly orange-yellow sandstorm desert; the girl Gaia (short black bob, olive-green work jacket now dusty, white canvas sneakers worn through) walks beside a rusty old humanoid robot with oil dripping from its knee joints; far away a colossal space elevator cable rises from the ground into the haze toward the sky. Film grain, vignette. No text.

assets.purpose: 第四段「月」章节静帧与走廊背景
assets.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, 16:9, perfectly symmetrical one-point perspective. A long seamless cold titanium-white corridor inside the moon, shadowless diffuse light, cold grey palette; the small figure of the girl Gaia (short black bob, olive-green work jacket, white canvas sneakers) seen from behind in the exact center walking toward a distant closed white door. Sterile, silent. Film grain. No text.

assets.purpose: 尾声「种」章节静帧 / 结局「起」结局卡背景
assets.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic wide film still, 16:9. Vast grey-yellow barren earth seen from high above, a single thin line of fresh green sprouting across the land; first raindrops falling; in the sky the moon is split open with a missing chunk; tiny hand emerging from the soil in the foreground. Muted palette with only that green as color. Film grain, vignette. No text.

assets.purpose: 授权书终局「贴上母亲的身份卡」的道具贴图
assets.prompt: Photorealistic worn plastic identity card, top-down view, scratched and slightly bent, faded photo area showing only a blurred backlit silhouette of a woman, small chip, no readable text, no letters, transparent background.

assets.purpose: 结局「施工完成」结局卡背景
assets.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, 16:9. An empty coastal town wiped perfectly clean under blinding overexposed white light, no people, no laundry, the green water tank faded to white, absolute stillness; near-white palette. Film grain. No text.

assets.purpose: 结局「我等了很久」结局卡背景
assets.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, 16:9, perfectly symmetrical. A sealed titanium-white room lit evenly forever, a single bowl of hot soup steaming on a white table, an unsigned sheet of paper beside it, an empty chair. Cold grey palette with only the faint steam. Film grain. No text on the paper visible.
usedIn: 结局卡 我等了很久
